# Brand & Visual Direction

Decide what the product should feel like: positioning, palette, type, logo and mood boards.

<a id="creative-direction"></a>
### Creative Direction

`design-superpowers:creative` · skill · **core** · phases: Direction

Explores visual direction: mood boards, palettes, typography systems, art direction.

**Use when**
- Producing 2-3 distinct visual directions for the client to choose from

**Avoid when**
- Direction already chosen: move to design

**How to use**
- Present directions as live themes (see site/ Themes page), not abstract adjectives

**Pairs with:** [Frontend Design](uiux.md#frontend-design) · [Brand Brief](brand.md#brand-brief)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/06-themes.md](../../docs/design/06-themes.md)

<a id="brand-brief"></a>
### Brand Brief

`brand-studio:brand-brief` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Direction

Turns brand decisions into a practical production brief: principles, assets, constraints.

**Use when**
- Translating 'I want it calm and luxurious' into concrete design inputs

**Avoid when**
- No brand decisions exist yet: run brand-strategy or ask the client

**How to use**
- Output feeds templates/design-direction.md

**Pairs with:** [Brand Identity System](brand.md#brand-identity-system) · [Creative Direction](brand.md#creative-direction)

**If not installed:** follow [templates/design-direction.md](../../templates/design-direction.md)

<a id="brand-style"></a>
### Brand Style (Small Business)

`small-business:brand-style` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Direction

Captures a small business's look from a website link or a plain-words description.

**Use when**
- The client has a website or Instagram: extract colors and tone from it quickly

**Avoid when**
- Formal identity work

**How to use**
- Paste the client's website URL; map the result to design-system tokens

**Pairs with:** [Map Design (extract DESIGN.md)](brand.md#map-design)

<a id="map-design"></a>
### Map Design (extract DESIGN.md)

`design-superpowers:map-design` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Direction

Extracts a design language from a screenshot, URL, Figma file or codebase into a DESIGN.md.

**Use when**
- The client shows apps or sites whose look they love
- Documenting the final token set

**How to use**
- Run on 2-3 reference screenshots, then merge into one token set

<a id="brand-strategy"></a>
### Brand Strategy

`brand-studio:brand-strategy` · skill · **optional** · phases: Direction

Positioning, audience, personality and promise. The 'why' behind the look.

**Use when**
- The client's business has no clear brand yet

**Avoid when**
- The client already has a brand guide: reuse it

**How to use**
- Keep to one page; the dashboard is internal, so personality matters more than positioning

**Pairs with:** [Brand Brief](brand.md#brand-brief)

### CoDesign: Create

`codesign:create` · skill · **optional** · phases: Direction

Generates visual designs (posters, social posts, decks, mood boards) on the IMG.LY CoDesign canvas.

- Making a launch graphic for the client

**Avoid when**

**How to use**
